Tim's material does not securely place Mediomu as a Dog or Mud Dweller; the stronger symbolic image is threshold/bridge-building, with skepticism functioning as friction rather than a settled lower caste.

karma.reading: No secure Tim-attributed positive or negative karma balance for Mediomu is recovered. Repair/building scenes are generative signals; hostile or skeptical statements are not by themselves a karma score.
